items.q: How many kg can I lose per month?
items.a: A healthy and sustainable rate is 4 to 6 kg per month, depending on your current weight, age, body fat percentage, activity level, and overall health. Slow and steady weight loss is the safest approach — it preserves muscle mass and prevents the yo-yo effect (regaining weight after dieting). Batoula designs a personalized plan that ensures real fat loss, not just water or muscle loss.

items.q: Is there a diet plan for pregnant women?
items.a: Absolutely! Batoula offers scientifically-based, safe nutrition plans for pregnant women that focus on providing all the essential vitamins and minerals for both mother and baby (iron, calcium, folic acid, omega-3). The goal isn't weight loss during pregnancy, but rather organizing nutrition to ensure a healthy pregnancy and prevent excessive weight gain.

items.q: Is there a diet plan for breastfeeding mothers?
items.a: Yes, with a carefully designed system! The plan ensures sufficient and nutritious milk production for your baby, while helping you gradually and safely lose the extra weight gained during pregnancy. We focus on protein-rich foods, calcium, and adequate hydration, while avoiding any extreme diets that could affect breastfeeding.

items.q: Is the follow-up with Batoula personally?
items.a: Yes, 100%! Follow-up is directly and personally with Batoula via WhatsApp. There are no assistants or other team members — Batoula is the one who designs your plan, tracks your progress, answers your questions, and adjusts the system based on your needs. This is one of the program's key advantages: genuine personal follow-up, not just a generic pre-made plan.

The choice is yours! Private follow-up (one-on-one) is available for complete privacy and a fully customized plan. You can also join a support group with other women on the same journey — the group gives you extra motivation, a supportive community, and shared experiences. Many women choose both options together!

Almost immediately! Once payment is confirmed, Batoula will contact you within 12 hours maximum to schedule your first consultation call. During this call, we'll assess your health status in detail and define your goals, then you'll receive your personalized diet plan and fitness routine. From payment to starting your transformation — it takes no more than a day or two!
